Publishing handoff

With Meta connected once, Schedule sends pieces to Meta's clock (Facebook natively; Instagram fires from this Mac at the minute) after your confirm. Without a token, captions + exports are prepared locally and final publishing stays in Meta Business Suite by hand.

  1. Meta Business Suite → Settings → Users → System users → Add.
  2. Assign your Facebook Page + Instagram account (@doalfaaz).
  3. Generate token with: pages_manage_posts, pages_read_engagement, instagram_basic, instagram_content_publish. For live Grow/Launch insights also add: read_insights, instagram_manage_insights, pages_read_user_content. If Publishing handoff still looks disconnected, close and reopen the gear — CE re-probes the token on disk.
  4. Paste it here → Save & test. The token stays on this Mac (0600 file); only yes/no ever comes back to the app UI.
